CREORDICS

The thermodynamic foundations of order creation

A research initiative exploring how complex systems create order through thermodynamic principles. We investigate universal patterns governing energy, information, and organization.

Recent advances in non-equilibrium thermodynamics suggest a unifying principle underlying all self-organizing systems. Evidence points toward a deeper pattern waiting to be formalized.

Research Questions

  • How do systems optimize exergy extraction across multiple scales?
  • What role does consciousness play in accelerating entropy production?
  • Can we quantify the thermodynamic efficiency of decision-making?
  • How does information processing relate to gradient exploitation?
  • What are the fundamental limits of order creation?

About

Founded by Ethan Jon. This initiative combines rigorous scientific inquiry with practical applications across disciplines.

Initial focus: developing a mathematical framework that unifies existing theories while making testable predictions.

Collaborate

Seeking researchers in: thermodynamics, complex systems, theoretical biology, statistical mechanics, information theory, nonlinear dynamics.
